t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Different colour gnomes find different numbers of mushroom so you need to figure out which gnomes give the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Number of mushrooms is determined by the basket colour. One will provide more than the other. The basket colour will change if you choose a gnome whose colour is very different to the basket. So if a red basket is giving the most mushrooms, choose red, purple, brown gnomes rather than blue, yellow, green ones. Eventually, the good basket will start to give less mushrooms and you should switch to the other colour.
